classification_notes: Manchester City discloses matchday, broadcasting, and commercial revenue directly in the annual accounts, with broadcasting split between UEFA and all-other lines that have been combined here. Player-trading profit is disclosed separately and excluded from football revenue.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the report.
non_football_revenue_notes: Other commercial activities may include sponsorship, hospitality, and other club commercial operations.
source_document: Full accounts made up to 30 June 2022
notes: Values in the annual report were disclosed in GBP thousands and have been converted here into full GBP amounts by multiplying by 1,000. The report cautions that comparisons with the prior year should be read carefully because the prior year remained affected by COVID-19 disruption. Net debt has been computed from lease liabilities less cash at bank and in hand from the balance sheet.
